// diagnostic

E0934

A trait constant value is not of its declared type

What

A trait constant value is not of its declared type

Why

The trait declares each constant's type, and each value has that type

Fix

Write a value of the declared type

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0934: tests/ui/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.stderr.

Error [jet.AmbiguousTraitConstant]: The impl gives the constant `sites` twice
  --> tests/ui/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:8:9
    |
  8 |         sites: [.Method]
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: An implementation has one value for each trait constant
 Fix: Remove one `sites: …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0937

Error [jet.UnknownTraitConstant]: `colour` is not a constant of `Marker`
  --> tests/ui/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:9:9
    |
  9 |         colour: .Red
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares
 Fix: Remove `colour`, or declare `colour: Type` in `Marker`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0936

Error [jet.TraitConstantTypeMismatch]: The value of trait constant `repeatable` is not of type `Bool`
  --> tests/ui/marker_settings_are_marker_constants.jet:10:21
    |
 10 |         repeatable: 3
    |                     ^
 Why: `Marker` declares `repeatable: Bool`, and each value has that type
 Fix: Write a value of type `Bool`
